dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Continuous symmetrical tapering from the mid-section toward the posterior, with a consistent reduction in pixel-width along the longitudinal axis.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Absence of significant bulges or indentations along the lateral margins; the contour follows a smooth, streamlined convex path.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light gray median intensity throughout the dorsal surface, with a prominent linear specular highlight along the dorsal ridge.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse darker gray pigmentation clusters on the cranial and lateral surfaces.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Broad, diffuse gradients between the lighter dorsal ridge and darker lateral tones.

other_distinctive_markers: Centrally located, high-contrast dark circular aperture representing the blowhole.
